bull.t: Large engaged user base supports durable advertising scale
bull.b: Meta’s enormous daily user base across multiple leading platforms gives advertisers broad reach and creates durable engagement advantages. Scale also supports better ad targeting, measurement, and optimization, strengthening the core advertising model and providing a foundation for continued monetization.

bull.t: AI tools and new services are expanding monetization
bull.b: Growth in paid messaging, subscriptions, business agents, and APIs shows Meta is building revenue streams beyond conventional feed advertising. These products can deepen business usage across WhatsApp and Messenger, diversify monetization, and increase the long-term value of its ecosystem.

bull.t: Elite profitability and strong operating cash conversion
bull.b: Very high margins and substantial operating cash flow indicate a highly profitable platform with strong underlying earnings quality. This financial strength gives Meta capacity to fund AI infrastructure, product development, and strategic initiatives while retaining meaningful resilience through changing market conditions.

bear.t: Heavy AI infrastructure spending is reducing free cash flow
bear.b: Meta’s AI and data-center build-out requires unusually large capital commitments that are consuming much of its operating cash generation. If this investment cycle persists, lower free cash flow could limit financial flexibility and increase the execution burden required to earn attractive returns.

bear.t: Legal and regulatory exposure can materially affect results
bear.b: Ongoing legal and regulatory proceedings create a durable source of financial and operational uncertainty for Meta. Potential charges, compliance requirements, or restrictions on products and practices could pressure margins, management attention, and the company’s ability to deploy its platforms consistently.

bear.t: Debt has risen as Meta funds infrastructure expansion
bear.b: Although leverage remains described as reasonable and equity has grown, the substantial upward debt trajectory adds financial obligations as Meta commits heavily to infrastructure. Higher debt can reduce flexibility for future investment or shareholder returns if operating conditions or project economics weaken.
